case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar. Need: 94800 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 10 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200008. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70710.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Georg Aigner,

Thank you for setting out the cost weights behind your quote. We recognise that the cited indices have risen, but the calculation needs to reflect your existing alloy coverage and avoid duplicate recovery.

By the figures you gave us - AS-14404 +5.9% at 45% of your cost, LCI-C +2.7% at 5% of your cost, PPI-C2431 +12.3% at 38% of your cost - the weighted effect on the price is about +7.5%, not the 11.01% you ask for. Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 88.0% (sc:70710@2026Q3).

A longer fixed-price agreement gives you commercial continuity while giving us a clear purchasing basis. We are flexible on payment timing; the shortest-payment option retains your requested net payment term, so please indicate which package works best for you.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.17 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option B: EUR 5.11 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option C: EUR 5.12 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We value our partnership and look forward to reconciling the price basis with you.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have reviewed your calculation of the weighted index effects and acknowledge the verified delivery performance, which we have factored into our revised proposal. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. While we welcome the stability of a 24-month agreement, we cannot fix the price over this period and must apply an AS-14404 index clause to manage raw material volatility.

By incorporating this index clause and maintaining the 30-day net payment term, we are able to offer a reduced base price of EUR 5.51 per unit. As an alternative, we can provide a price of €5.51 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.51 per unit.

Our current offer stands at a price of €5.46 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Georg Aigner,

Thank you for lowering your base-price offer and recognising the verified delivery performance. We understand your need for protection against material-cost exposure rather than a price freeze throughout the agreement.

We are taking a modest step by accepting an alloy-index clause in exchange for a lower base price; the option with no deadband gives you the most direct protection against material movements. The longer agreement provides commercial continuity, and we are flexible on the deadband, so please choose the option that works best for you.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.24 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 5% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 5.13 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 0% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option C: EUR 5.20 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 3% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.

We appreciate your constructive engagement and look forward to agreeing a transparent price basis.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
